cases.name: native workspace settings load their name sources directory and policy
rename keeps the native dialog and saves the trimmed workspace name
permission mode and Execute autonomy save through the original callbacks
mode cycling persists valid selections and refuses fewer than two modes
default sources update and live source removal heals the saved selection
invalid cost JSON stays visible without saving and a valid policy saves
the native folder picker selects a directory and Clear persists the empty value
the local MCP toggle saves through the native workspace setting

limits: Workspace settings and sources are QA objects in memory; no real files, credentials or accounting data are changed.
